name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A compact row of icon buttons for bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and text alignment. Each button holds a light grey fill while it is on, and clicks flip one without touching the others.
use: A small group of independent formatting or view options that a user switches on and off.
avoid: Not for mutually exclusive choices; independent toggles let every icon stay pressed at once.
a11y: Each control is a real button with a focus ring, but the demo supplies its aria-labels; the component itself provides none. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card shows a thin toolbar of seven square icon buttons: four text-style icons, a small vertical divider, then three alignment icons. Pressed buttons sit in a light grey fill while the rest are transparent, and a sample paragraph fills the space below.
behaves: Clicking an icon button flips it between plain and a grey pressed state on its own, so several can be lit at once. The frames show italic, strikethrough and align-centre being switched on in turn while the defaults stay pressed.
customise: Size (sm, default, lg) and variant (default, outline) come as props; the button's icon is passed as children and pressed styling lives in the variant classes.
weight: light: One small button per control, CSS transitions only, nothing running at rest.
demo: Release notes v2.4 heading with a short paragraph about pressed states.
polishWhy: Tidy compact toolbar with even spacing, but the toggles are visually plain.
